list.item: The student will evaluate data collected to determine if they fit either the uniform or exponential distributions.

note.p: Collect the Data Go to your local supermarket. Ask 30 people as they leave for the total amount on their grocery receipts. (Or, ask three cashiers for the last ten amounts. Be sure to include the express lane, if it is open.)

list.item: Record the values.
Construct a histogram of the data. Make five to six intervals. Sketch the graph using a ruler and pencil. Scale the axes.
